children: Sana Biotechnology released an updated corporate presentation outlining progress toward filing an IND for SC451 this year and advances in in vivo CAR T fusosome programs.
Announced updated corporate presentation to be discussed at investor conferences; furnished as Exhibit 99.1.
SC451 (hypoimmune stem cell‑derived islet therapy): goal to file IND and begin Phase 1/2 in 2026; nonclinical testing and GLP tox nearing completion.
Reported clinical validation UP421 showed immune evasion, cell survival and function through 14 months with no therapy‑related adverse events.
Fusosome in vivo CAR T platform (SG293, SG227) showed potent CD8+ transduction and B‑cell depletion in NHPs; SG293 first‑in‑human NHL data targeted 1H 2027.
Manufacturing progress: GMP master and working cell banks completed; tech transfer to CDMOs and clinical site activation underway.

title: Sana Biotechnology updates corporate presentation, targets SC451 IND and unveils in vivo CAR T progress
